title: Label Semantic Expansion via Label Guided Neural Topic Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2608.30216v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Topic models are widely used for content analysis, where users often analyze corpora around predefined labels rather than unordered latent topics. Existing label-aware topic models mainly follow a labels-for-topics perspective, using labels to guide topic learning, while the learned topics are not directly usable for label-centered analysis. We explore the reverse topics-for-labels perspective and instantiate it as Label Semantic Expansion (LSE), which enriches sparse label representations with corpus-grounded descriptive topic words. To exploit topics in LSE effectively, we propose a Label-Guided Neural Topic Model (LGNTM), which learns dedicated label-aligned topics, grounds them in lexical and document semantic spaces, and preserves consistency between topic structures and label structures. translated_title: 基于标签引导神经主题模型的标签语义扩展
translated_abstract: 主题模型被广泛用于内容分析，用户通常围绕预定义的标签而非无序的潜在主题来分析语料库。现有的标签感知主题模型主要遵循“标签到主题”的视角，即利用标签来指导主题学习，而学到的主题并不能直接用于以标签为中心的分析。我们探索了相反的“主题到标签”视角，并将其具体化为标签语义扩展（LSE），即利用基于语料库的描述性主题词来丰富稀疏的标签表示。为了在LSE中有效利用主题，我们提出了一种标签引导神经主题模型（LGNTM），该模型学习专门与标签对齐的主题，将其扎根于词汇和文档语义空间，并保持主题结构与标签结构之间的一致性。在标签-主题对齐、标签扩展、主题质量和下游分类任务上的实验表明，该方法展现出强劲的整体性能。
tldr: 该论文提出标签引导神经主题模型（LGNTM），从“主题到标签”的新视角实现标签语义扩展，利用与标签对齐的主题词丰富稀疏标签表示，并保持主题结构与标签结构的一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Label-Guided Neural Topic Model (LGNTM) that enables Label Semantic Expansion from a novel topics-for-labels perspective, enriching sparse label representations with label-aligned topic words while preserving consistency between topic and label structures.
